# BURST Oral Care

> > BURST Oral Care offers clinically-proven electric toothbrushes, floss, probiotics, and whitening products designed for professional-grade at-home dental care.

BURST Oral Care specializes in innovative oral health products featuring advanced technologies like sonic toothbrushes, expanding floss, and oral probiotics with BLIS strains. The product line spans professional-grade electric toothbrushes, eco-friendly floss solutions, whitening systems, and dedicated kids' oral care with dentist-approved formulations.
